# Binding rules for agents working in this repo

These rules are enforced by CI. Violating one fails the build. To change a rule you must supersede its decision — author a replacement, mark this one superseded, update the control and its pragma, and rebuild this view. Never edit code to evade a control.

- **[DEC-0] No file under `governance/views/` may be named `AGENTS.md`, and `governance/views/RULES.md` must exist.** (block)
- **[DEC-2] A call to `exec` or `eval` may appear only in `src/seshat/verify.py`. No other first-party Python file in this repo may call either — every `.py` file under the repo root, excluding any path with a hidden (dot-prefixed) directory component, excluding `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `build/`, and `__pycache__/` wherever they occur, and excluding `tests/fixtures/`, which is committed probe-repo data, never linted or rewritten. A symlinked directory is never followed, regardless of what it points to or where it resolves; code reachable only through one is not scanned and is not covered by this rule, and meeting one is reported informationally, not as a violation.** (block)
- **[DEC-3] Every `.py` module directly under `controls/fitness/` (other than `__init__.py`) has a corresponding `tests/controls/test_<stem>.py` module, and that module defines at least one `test_*` function. A control with a missing or empty test module fails the build.** (block)
